facts.text: Hot dog at the turn, beer on the eighteenth. Anyone eating Grandma's cookies sits away from me.
facts.why: Happy does not say this in the film, and Grandma's cookies are not a gag in the film. A real line fits the golf theme better.

vibe.verdict: Same stadium shell, but nearly every famous gag now prints in the item names and notes, and the photos suit the golf course.
ideas: Swap 'Happy's lemon shandy pitchers' note for a 'Happy place' drink with a daisy garnish.
Rename 'Hockey puck cheeseburger sliders' to 'Slap shot sliders' and add the Shooter gold jacket as a dessert, a gold leaf cake.
Replace 'Grandma's biscuits' with 'Alligator bites' (battered prawns) to use the Chubbs gag.
